deploy-bot: [deploy] staging deploy started
Environment: staging
Commit: a1b2c3d4
Tag: release/v2.4.0-rc1
Initiator: alex

deploy-bot: rolling out to 4 clusters, will shift canary at 25% -> 100% over 10m

alex: noted. I'm watching smoke tests.

maya: quick heads up — running the reranker smoke now, will report back in ~3m

deploy-bot: canary shift 25% complete ✅

sam: seeing a small spike in 503s from cluster eu-west-1, +~0.4% — investigating

maya: logs show model load latency increased on a subset; comparing infra metrics

devops: adding a temporary pin to old tag for eu-west-1 while we triage

alex: please hold further traffic shift. Maya — do we have enough info to rollback or patch?

maya: initial look points to quantization mismatch in the new image on that GPU type. Suggest rollback for eu-west-1 only.

devops: rolling back eu-west-1 to tag release/v2.3.9 now

deploy-bot: [rollback] eu-west-1 rollback started -> target tag release/v2.3.9

devops: command used:
```
rb-deploy --env=staging --cluster=eu-west-1 --tag=release/v2.3.9 --reason="quant mismatch"
```

deploy-bot: eu-west-1 rollback completed ✅ (1851234592)

sam: 503s dropped back to baseline, latency stabilized. Good.

alex: canary traffic paused, do not resume until we validate a fix. Pining staging default to release/v2.3.9

deploy-bot: pin applied: staging default -> release/v2.3.9

maya: I'll open a follow-up PR to fix quant config, tagging infra and runtime-owning teams.

alex: thanks. Create a short release note in the release-notes issue summarizing the partial rollback and next steps.

sam: noted, will update the incident log with timestamps and metrics snapshot.

deploy-bot: [deploy] staging deploy aborted for remaining clusters — status: halted by operator

alex: closing thread, we'll target a rebuilt image for a re-deploy after PR merge and full smoke. :thumbsup:
